Each iteration call sub_464B10 (0x00464B10) on the current record pointer with the integer part v4, storing its return value as result.
Write the fractional remainder back: this[26] = v3 - v4 * 0.0049999999, keeping the leftover in the accumulator.
Return the last result produced by sub_464B10.
